text:
alex: FYI small outage: east-west mTLS failures between svc-store -> svc-search in apac after tonight's keystore migration.
maya: seeing it too, +80% handshake errors from apac pool.
liam: grabbed proxy logs, showing `unknown_ca` on server side, clients show `certificate_verify_failed`.
certd-bot: alert: certd: signing failed: KMSGenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintextAccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:apac:...:key/03ab
alex: that KMS key was rotated as part of the migration and we updated key alias -> new-key-2026. Did the migration include updating the certd role policy?
maya: we pushed a new IAM policy to `certd-role` at 01:08Z: allows kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext on the new key. Policy diff looked fine.
liam: but CloudTrail shows principals `certd@apac-node-xx` getting AccessDenied on GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext between 01:09-01:12Z.
sec-oncall: can someone paste the CloudTrail events? We need to know whether it's a key policy deny or IAM deny.
alex: pasted event snippet:
```
{ EventTime: "2026-03-21T01:10:23Z", EventName: "GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext", UserIdentity: { Arn: "arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/certd-role/certd" }, ErrorCode: "AccessDeniedException", ErrorMessage: "Caller is not authorized to use this KMS key" }
```
liam: that error string implies key policy denied IAM principal. We probably forgot to update key's resource policy to include the new certd role ARN for apac nodes. Key was re-created and alias pointed, but key policy left restrictive.
maya: ok that explains why only apac region impacted (we migrated apac key last). eu/prod still on old key and fine.
sec-oncall: mitigation options: 1) add the certd-role principal to key policy (fast), 2) create a KMS Grant for the certd-role (safer for rollouts), 3) temporarily revert alias to old key (if available). Which is fastest?
alex: we can patch key policy quickly but it's an audit-sensitive change. Ops prefers Grants to avoid policy churn. Can we create a Grant scoped to GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext for the role?
liam: yes `aws kms create-grant --key-id <id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/certd-role --operations GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext --name certd-apac-temp` should do it, but grants expire only when revoked or when the principal is deleted; still OK for hotfix.
maya: I made the grant at 01:18Z and traffic recovered to baseline within 30s. Handshake errors dropped to <1%.
sec-oncall: good. Now follow-ups for compliance: document why key policy diverged, attach CloudTrail evidence, and ensure key rotation runbooks include updating both key policy and any regional role ARNs.
alex: root cause: keystore migration re-keyed apac key and alias, but runbook step to patch resource-based policy to include `certd-role@apac` was skipped. Also our CI did not validate key policy -> role mapping.
liam: longer-term engineering actions I propose:
- add a pre-migration checklist item: `verify-key-policy-includes:[list-of-regional-roles]`
- bake an integration test that, given key alias, asserts `Allow` for GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext for each region's certd role by calling `kms:SimulatePrincipalPolicy` or a dry-run grant
- emit certd metric `kms_grants_last_success_timestamp` and `kms_access_denied_count` to monitoring
- centralize key policy template and generate region-specific principals automatically in infra repo
maya: ops/security ask: can we avoid resource policy edits by always granting cross-account/service access via explicit Grants on deployment? That reduces audit noise.
sec-oncall: grants are less visible in key policy diffs but are still auditable in CloudTrail (CreateGrant). Compliance needs a record: add Grant creation events to migration ticket.
alex: also check for clock skew: I noticed one apac node had 2m drift which caused STS assume failures earlier in another incident; let's not repeat that.
liam: noted. I'll add node NTP check as part of the keystore migration gating.
maya: created ticket SEC-2026-204 with artifacts: CloudTrail snippets, grant creation, proxy logs, certd logs. Marking status: mitigated (grant applied), monitoring for 1h.
deploy-bot: grant creation recorded at 2026-03-21T01:18:32Z by maya.
sec-oncall: good job. Postmortem owners: liam (engineering fixes), alex (runbook update), maya (compliance artifacts). Target sprint for infra changes: next.
alex: one extra: let's add a preflight check that queries `kms:DescribeKey` and `kms:GetKeyPolicy` and fails the migration if `certd-role` missing.
liam: +1. I'll draft PR for integration test and policy template.
maya: thanks all, cc @compliance for record: https://internal.corp/audit/1763456790
sec-oncall: closing thread; monitoring still green. :white_check_mark:
